record.paper_title: Open problems, questions and challenges in finite-dimensional integrable systems
record.original_question: Compute the Jordan-Kronecker invariants for the most inter esting classes of Lie alge- bras, and particularly for the following (a) semidirect sums g +ρ V, where ρ: g → End(V ) is a representation of a semisimple Lie algebra g and V is assumed to be commutative; (b) Borel subalgebras of simple Lie algebras; (c) parabolic subalgebras of simple Lie algebras; (d ) the centralisers of singular elements a ∈ g, where g is simple; (e) Lie algebras of small dimensions. 26 For Lie algebras of dimension ≤ 5, the Jordan-Kronecker invariants were computed by P. Zhang. Her results, as well as some other examples of computing Jordan-Kron ecker invariants, can be found in the arXiv version of [38]. For some semidirect sums, Jordan-Kronec ker invariants have been recently computed by K. Vorushilov [224].

evidence.quote: Problem 5.6. Zhang. Her results, as well as some other examples of computing Jordan-Kron ecker invariants, can be found in the arXiv version of [38]. artifact.status_search_result: The problem is a broad computational program; partial progress has been made. Dimension ≤ 5 cases were computed by P. Zhang. Borel subalgebras of semisimple Lie algebras have been treated by K. S. Vorushilov, and further semidirect sum cases have been addressed in recent work (arXiv:2409.09535, 2024). Realization questions for Jordan–Kronecker invariants by Lie algebras have been studied (arXiv:2307.08642). The full classification problem—particularly for general parabolic subalgebras and centralizers of arbitrary singular elements—remains open.

status_evidence.title: Jordan–Kronecker invariants of finite-dimensional Lie algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces Jordan-Kronecker invariants and computes them for several classes including small-dimensional cases.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational work establishing the framework and computing invariants for some classes.

status_evidence.title: New techniques for calculation of Jordan-Kronecker invariants for Lie algebras and Lie algebra representations
status_evidence.snippet: Two novel techniques that simplify the calculation of Jordan-Kronecker invariants for Lie algebras and semidirect sums.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2024) progress on computing JK invariants of semidirect sums.

status_evidence.title: Realization of Jordan-Kronecker invariants by Lie algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Studies which tuples can occur as JK invariants of Lie algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on the realization side of the program.
